failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

invariant_ReportedAssetsAreBacked().notice: Assets never simply vanish: what the vault reports must be backed         by what it actually holds, idle plus its position at the venue.

invariant_SharePriceNeverFalls().notice: The share price may only ever go up. Yield accrues, donations         help, and nothing in this contract should destroy value.

invariant_SupplyMatchesHoldings().notice: Shares outstanding must equal what holders actually hold. Nobody         mints to an address the accounting does not know about — the fee         recipient included, which is the only other address that can         legitimately receive newly minted shares.

invariant_VaultCanCoverEveryClaim().notice: Solvency. Every holder redeeming at once must not ask for more         than the vault holds. If this breaks, someone is left short.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).
